title: Anti-drone technology fails at PSEG Salem/Hope Creek
place_text: Hope Creek Generating Station, Salem County, New Jersey

tellings.quote: they tried to deploy an anti-drone technology over multiple drones that were seen over the nuclear site and that anti- drone Dr technology which normally works on all drones completely failed

plain: A researcher who has long studied UFO sightings at nuclear sites, Robert Hastings, says an unnamed person who could see the internal messages of the Salem and Hope Creek nuclear power plants in New Jersey, run by the utility PSEG, told him about events in 2024. According to that source, several drones were seen over the plant, staff tried to use anti-drone equipment that normally works on any drone, and it failed completely. If true, the objects would be something beyond ordinary drones.
